title: Consolidated navigation
observed_behavior_before: web/src/lib/components/nav-model.js exported PRIMARY_NAV_LINKS and NAV_SECTIONS, creating duplicate navigation surfaces.
DNS and Notifications routes were absent from NAV_SECTIONS.
web/src/lib/components/Nav.svelte rendered primary shortcut links in the topbar and a dropdown-style all-destinations menu.
intended_behavior: NAV_SECTIONS is the single source of truth for page navigation.
Navigation is grouped into Workspace, Delivery, Operations, Intelligence, and Admin sections with section icons.
The topbar shows the menu trigger to the left of the logo and a breadcrumb derived from currentLocation(pathname).
The all-destinations menu opens as a left-side slide-out drawer with a backdrop overlay.
